_doc: Practised skills (systems/practiceSkills.js): skills that rise in levels by doing them, for the player and for NPCs alike. A holder keeps total XP by skill on holder.practiceSkills ({ diving: 120, swimming: 40 }); the level comes from the XP: reaching level L+1 from L takes round(xp.base * xp.growth^(L-1)) XP, up to maxLevel. levelNames: the word for each level (1-based). Each skill has perks, one value per level (index 0 = level 1); text says what a rise gives ({d}: the gain, {a}: its size either way, {v}: the new value) and show describes the value ({v}). Diving (player/diving.js): breath = seconds on one breath; coldResist = % of the cold's extra breath drain shrugged off; speed = % faster underwater; winded = seconds to recover after a dive to the limit (or a blackout); catchBreath = seconds after a dive with plenty of breath left (between the two by how much breath was spent). xp: perSecond under; limitMult on the whole dive when you surface with limitShare of breath or less (or black out); find / treasure for each common find / treasure off the bottom; swimmingPerSecond: swimming XP for time under. Swimming (player/swimming.js): energySaved = % less energy a stroke; speed = % faster strokes; xp per stroke swum. migrate: an old save's player.swimPractice (0..400 strokes of practice) becomes this many XP per point in each skill. npc: NPC skill levels seeded from who they are (systems/townsfolk.js persons and walking NPCs): base level by skill, plus by role, plus coastal (a town by the sea or a lake) for the water skills (and there coastalTrades: a share of some roles work the water as fishers, sailors or pearl divers, picked by a hash of who they are), plus up to spread more by a hash of who they are, and ageBonus a level per that many years over 20 (at most ageMax); children (under adultAge) get half. They grow by work: dailyXp by role (coastal ones for the water trades), reckoned each townsfolk season. notableLevel: the least level shown on an NPC's card.

diving.name: Diving
diving.desc: Holding your breath and working the bottom. Dive to your limit to learn it fastest; a dive to the very end of your breath leaves you winded a while.

coldResist.text: the cold takes {a}% less of your breath

winded.text: winded {a}s less after a deep dive
winded.show: {v}s winded after a dive to the limit

swimming.name: Swimming
swimming.desc: Strength and ease in the water: every stroke in deep water teaches it.
